description: List the messages the answering line took from callers for one of the signed-in owner's own lines, newest first. Each item has id, at (ISO), name, phone, message and urgent, so it holds callers' names and phone numbers. Pass the line_id from get_answering_line; limit sets the page size, and to read further back pass the previous result's next_before as before (next_before is null when there is nothing older). It reaches back through at most the 500 most recent messages. The calls themselves, with duration and summary, are in get_line_calls. Replies from businesses you contacted through Direct are in get_replies. Needs lines:manage; changes nothing; rate limited per account.

before.description: ISO timestamp cursor: only messages before this.

name: get_line_messages
title: One line's recent messages
